research_report:
### Cutoff and trigger
No Q2 result was public by the 03:41:47 ET cutoff. Circle scheduled the August 5 webcast for 08:00 ET; prior earnings 8-K exhibits arrived near 06:27 ET. The first complete earnings release/8-K exhibit—not the webcast, transcript, later 10-Q, or analyst reaction—is the trigger [S1][S2].

### Locked operating baseline
Q1 2026 reported reserve income $652.5M, other revenue $41.6M, total revenue and reserve income $694.1M, distribution/transaction/other costs $406.8M, RLDC $287.4M/41.4%, and adjusted EBITDA $151.4M/52.7% of RLDC. FY2026 guidance was Other Revenue $150–170M, RLDC margin 38–40%, adjusted operating expense $570–585M, and approximately 40% multi-year through-cycle USDC CAGR; Arc-token presale effects, incentives, and future Arc revenue were excluded [S2][S3].

Published reserve examinations show USDC of approximately $77.05B on March 31 and April 30, $75.89B on May 29, and $73.269B on June 30. Trapezoidal interpolation gives an inferred Q2 average near $76.33B; use $75.8–76.8B as the definition/rounding band. The June endpoint was already observable and is confirmation, not surprise [S4]. With reserve returns near the prior-quarter rate, the definition-matched mechanical neutral ranges are reserve income $666–685M, other revenue $38–43M, total revenue and reserve income $708–728M, RLDC $269–291M at 38–40%, adjusted operating expense about $145–150M, and current-definition adjusted EBITDA $125–143M. These are inferences, not issuer guidance. Dynamic vendor feeds conflicted materially on both revenue and EPS definitions, so EPS and stale consensus are non-gating [S14][S15].

RLDC equals total revenue and reserve income minus total distribution, transaction, and other costs. Adjusted EBITDA margin equals adjusted EBITDA divided by RLDC—not total revenue. Q1 2026 amended the non-GAAP definition to exclude payroll taxes tied to stock compensation. Any material Arc amount must be separated on the same scope because the standing guide excludes it [S2][S17].

### Causal model and candidate selection
CRCL is retained because reserve balances and returns drive gross reserve income; distribution economics determine retained RLDC; adjusted operating expense then determines adjusted EBITDA. The disclosure therefore directly changes CRCL earnings and forward unit-economics expectations.

COIN is rejected despite a real relationship. Coinbase receives USDC economics, but stronger Circle retention can help CRCL while reducing what flows to Coinbase; Coinbase had already reported Q2 and is dominated by its own trading and crypto exposures. Circle’s ordinary release also does not provide a reliable Coinbase-specific payout bridge, and COIN’s reactions across CRCL windows were inconsistent [S3][S11][S12]. PYPL is rejected because PYUSD is competitive rather than a direct transfer of Circle economics: stronger Circle results can validate the category or indicate USDC share gains against PYUSD. Neither COIN nor PYPL has adequate own-instrument, one-direction calibration for this event [S13].

Known competitive pressure is embedded: Open USD’s proposed yield pass-through model may force issuers to share more reserve income with distributors, while post-quarter USDC supply had continued weakening. These facts increase the importance of RLDC and forward guidance but are not themselves Q2 surprises [S5][S16].

### Comparable reactions and calibration
Price source is FinanceCharts adjusted NYSE CRCL closes, retrieved before cutoff [S9]. These are the reference-asset regular closes for the CRCLUSDT perpetual and implement the required BMO previous-close-to-disclosure-day-close convention; no other symbol’s volatility was substituted.

- 2025-08-12: $161.17 to $163.21, +1.27%. Revenue and growth were strong, but the first public quarter contained IPO accounting noise and lacked broad capture/outlook confirmation. The after-close secondary offering is excluded from the BMO window [S6].
- 2025-11-12: $98.30 to $86.30, -12.21%. Headline growth and adjusted EBITDA were strong, but rising operating costs, falling-yield sensitivity, competition, valuation, and insufficient forward improvement dominated [S7][S10].
- 2026-02-25: $61.37 to $83.14, +35.47%. A broad beat, delivery above prior Other Revenue guidance, and constructive initial FY2026 framework coincided with broader crypto strength; the observed magnitude is therefore capped for calibration [S8].
- 2026-05-11: $113.67 to $131.76, +15.91%. Revenue missed some feeds, while capture, adjusted EBITDA, maintained guidance, adoption, and the Arc presale supported the bundle [S2][S9].

The sole ordinary/non-resolving observation was +1.27%, supporting a no-action band of approximately -4% to +4%. Weak moves are locked at ±6%, outside that band. Medium moves are ±12%, anchored by the -12.21% observation and below the +15.91% positive event. Strong buy is +22%, below the crypto-confounded +35.47% tail; strong sell is -20%, a conservative same-symbol extrapolation beyond the only downside observation. Downside confidence is lower because CRCL has no clean strong-negative earnings precedent.

### Debate adjudication
After receiving all three independent memos, the common conflict packet challenged the consensus mismatch, axis construction, guidance omission, Arc definitions, known USDC endpoint, calibration, candidate locking, and historical attribution. All three rebuttals revised toward the official-data mechanical ranges, CRCL-only selection, a narrow no-action band, omission-neutral guidance for weak/medium, and mandatory ex-Arc/current-definition reconciliation. Calibration recommendations still ranged from ±6/±10/±15 to ±6/±12/±25; the locked values use the cross-memo center while shrinking the confounded positive tail. The final ladder uses concurrence across engine, capture, profit, and outlook; headline revenue or EPS cannot decide direction. Any opposing material axis is HOLD, accepting that a valuation-driven reaction such as Q3 cannot honestly be inferred from otherwise positive trailing results unless the first package itself supplies the adverse forward evidence.
analysis_brief:
### Extract from the first complete official Q2 2026 release/8-K

Use the three months ended June 30, 2026 and USD millions unless stated otherwise:

- Reserve income (`RI`), Other Revenue (`O`), and reported Total Revenue and Reserve Income (`T_reported`).
- Any Arc-token revenue, gain, fair-value effect, incentive, or associated cost included in those figures; obtain the numerical ex-Arc bridge.
- Total Distribution, Transaction and Other Costs (`C`).
- Reported RLDC and RLDC margin.
- Adjusted Operating Expense.
- Adjusted EBITDA (`A`), its GAAP reconciliation, exclusions, and stated margin denominator.
- Average daily and June 30 USDC circulation; average reserve assets if separately given; Reserve Return Rate and its period convention.
- FY2026 guidance, on a like-for-like ex-Arc basis, for Other Revenue, RLDC margin, Adjusted Operating Expense, and the through-cycle USDC CAGR objective.
- Any reserve deficiency/depeg, attestation or counterparty problem, material security incident, partner termination, binding regulatory restriction, restatement, or release/8-K conflict.

### Locked definitions and baselines

- `T = T_reported − separately quantified Arc operating revenue/gains`; if no Arc item entered the top line, `T=T_reported`.
- `L = T − C`; `M = 100 × L / T`.
- `A` must use the Q1 2026 definition, including the payroll-tax-on-stock-compensation exclusion, with material Arc items removed.
- `AM = 100 × A / L`; do not divide by total revenue.
- Neutral mechanical ranges: average USDC $75.8–76.8B; June 30 USDC approximately $73.269B; `RI` $666–685M; `O` $38–43M; `T` $708–728M; `L` $269–291M; `M` 38–40%; `A` $125–143M; `AM` approximately 46–50%.
- Prior FY2026 guidance: Other Revenue $150–170M; RLDC margin 38–40%; Adjusted Operating Expense $570–585M; USDC approximately 40% multi-year through-cycle CAGR. Reaffirmation or silence is neutral; compare revised range endpoints and midpoints on the old ex-Arc scope.

### Calculations and comparison order

1. Apply integrity/veto checks and reconcile release versus 8-K.
2. Remove material Arc effects and verify the current non-GAAP definition.
3. Recalculate `L`, `M`, and `AM`; compare reported values with the calculations allowing only rounding.
4. If average reserve assets and the issuer’s annualization convention are disclosed, recompute implied reserve income from average reserve assets × Reserve Return Rate × period fraction. Do not substitute average USDC circulation for average reserve assets.
5. Compare operating engine first, then retained economics, then adjusted profit, and finally like-for-like guidance. Treat EPS, GAAP net income, end-period USDC alone, qualitative partnerships, CPN/Arc milestones, and later call commentary as non-gating.

Classification is impossible if `T`, `C`, current-definition `A`, or the adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation is absent; if material Arc effects cannot be separated; if a same-definition June 30 USDC figure differs from $73.269B by more than $0.5B without a bridge; or if an issuer-input reserve-income identity differs by more than 3% without explanation. Missing RI/O split makes the engine unavailable but does not by itself invalidate independently complete retained-economics and profit evidence. Missing guidance is neutral for weaker classifications; optional platform metrics and later-filing details never gate them.

STRONG_BUY.condition: Using only the first complete official Q2 2026 release/8-K for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (USD millions), set RI=Reserve Income, O=Other Revenue, T=RI+O after removing separately quantified Arc-token operating revenue/gains, C=Total Distribution, Transaction and Other Costs on the same scope, L=T−C, M=100×L/T, A=Adjusted EBITDA under the Q1 2026 definition after removing separately quantified Arc effects, and AM=100×A/L. Engine+ means at least two of RI>685, O>43, T>728; Capture+ means L>291 and M>40; Profit+ means A>143 and AM>50. A favorable outlook item means: the ex-Arc FY2026 Other Revenue range has neither endpoint lower and midpoint>160; RLDC-margin range has neither endpoint lower and midpoint>39; Adjusted Operating Expense range has neither endpoint higher and midpoint<577.5; or through-cycle USDC CAGR is >40%. Outlook+ requires at least one favorable and no adverse item. Decisive Engine+ means at least two of RI≥695, O≥48, T≥740; decisive Capture+ means L≥300 and M≥41; decisive Profit+ means A≥155 and AM≥53. Select STRONG_BUY only when Engine+, Capture+, Profit+, and Outlook+ all hold, at least two of the three operating axes are decisive, no component or guidance item points materially negative, and all integrity checks pass. Integrity requires T, C, A and the current-definition reconciliation; any Arc effect exceeding 1% of T or A or crossing a threshold must have an ex-Arc bridge; same-definition June 30 USDC must reconcile within $0.5B of $73.269B; any issuer-input reserve-income identity difference over 3% must be explained; and there must be no material reserve deficiency/depeg, attestation conflict, security incident, partner termination, binding regulatory restriction, or release/8-K conflict. Evaluate before medium and weak tiers.

MEDIUM_BUY.condition: Using only the first complete official Q2 2026 release/8-K for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (USD millions), set RI=Reserve Income, O=Other Revenue, T=RI+O after removing separately quantified Arc-token operating revenue/gains, C=Total Distribution, Transaction and Other Costs on the same scope, L=T−C, M=100×L/T, A=current-definition Adjusted EBITDA after removing separately quantified Arc effects, and AM=100×A/L. Engine+ means at least two of RI>685, O>43, T>728; Capture+ means L>291 and M>40; Profit+ means A>143 and AM>50. Engine− means at least two of RI<666, O<38, T<708; Capture− means L<269 and M<38; Profit− means A<125 and AM<46. Outlook+ means at least one unambiguously favorable and no adverse like-for-like change versus ex-Arc FY2026 guidance of Other Revenue $150–170M, RLDC margin 38–40%, Adjusted Operating Expense $570–585M, and through-cycle USDC CAGR 40%; Outlook− is the reverse. Reaffirmed or omitted guidance is neutral; explicit withdrawal is adverse; opposing or unbridged Arc-inclusive changes are mixed. After excluding STRONG_BUY, select MEDIUM_BUY when at least two of Engine+, Capture+, Profit+, and Outlook+ hold, at least one is Capture+ or Profit+, no Engine−, Capture−, Profit−, Outlook−, or internally mixed axis exists, and the integrity checks in this condition pass. Integrity requires T, C, A and its Q1-2026-definition reconciliation; a numerical bridge for any material Arc contamination; same-definition June 30 USDC within $0.5B of $73.269B or an explanation; explanation of any issuer-input reserve-income identity difference over 3%; and no material reserve/depeg, attestation, security, partner, regulatory, or release/8-K conflict. Neutral secondary evidence is permitted.

WEAK_BUY.condition: Using only the first complete official Q2 2026 release/8-K for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (USD millions), set RI=Reserve Income, O=Other Revenue, T=RI+O after removing separately quantified Arc-token operating revenue/gains, C=Total Distribution, Transaction and Other Costs on the same scope, L=T−C, M=100×L/T, A=current-definition Adjusted EBITDA after removing separately quantified Arc effects, and AM=100×A/L. Engine+ means at least two of RI>685, O>43, T>728; Capture+ means L>291 and M>40; Profit+ means A>143 and AM>50. Engine− means at least two of RI<666, O<38, T<708; Capture− means L<269 and M<38; Profit− means A<125 and AM<46. Outlook+ means at least one unambiguously favorable and no adverse like-for-like revision from ex-Arc FY2026 guidance of Other Revenue $150–170M, RLDC margin 38–40%, Adjusted Operating Expense $570–585M, or through-cycle USDC CAGR 40%; Outlook− is the reverse. Reaffirmed or omitted guidance is neutral; withdrawal is adverse; unbridged Arc-inclusive or opposite-direction changes are mixed. After excluding stronger buy tiers, select WEAK_BUY when at least one of Engine+, Capture+, Profit+, or Outlook+ holds, every remaining axis is neutral or positive, and no Engine−, Capture−, Profit−, Outlook−, internal metric conflict, or mixed guidance exists. This does not require every field to beat. Integrity requires T, C, A and its Q1-2026-definition reconciliation; a bridge for material Arc effects; same-definition June 30 USDC within $0.5B of $73.269B or an explanation; explanation of an issuer-input reserve-income identity difference over 3%; and no material reserve/depeg, attestation, security, partner, regulatory, or release/8-K conflict.

HOLD.condition: First apply HOLD vetoes using only the first complete official Q2 2026 release/8-K for the three months ended June 30, 2026. HOLD if total revenue and reserve income, total distribution/transaction/other costs, current-definition Adjusted EBITDA, or its reconciliation is missing; if the Q1 2026 non-GAAP definition cannot be reproduced; if an Arc effect exceeding 1% of total revenue or Adjusted EBITDA or sufficient to cross a threshold lacks a numerical ex-Arc bridge; if same-definition June 30 USDC differs by more than $0.5B from $73.269B without reconciliation; if reserve income differs by more than 3% from an identity using the issuer's own reported average reserve assets, Reserve Return Rate, and period convention without explanation; if release and 8-K materially conflict; or if a material reserve deficiency/depeg, attestation problem, security incident, partner termination, binding regulatory restriction, or restatement makes the ordinary earnings calibration unreliable. Otherwise define RI=Reserve Income, O=Other Revenue, T=RI+O ex-Arc, C=costs, L=T−C, M=100×L/T, A=current-definition ex-Arc Adjusted EBITDA, and AM=100×A/L. Positive axes are: Engine+, at least two of RI>685, O>43, T>728; Capture+, L>291 and M>40; Profit+, A>143 and AM>50; and Outlook+, at least one favorable and no adverse like-for-like revision from ex-Arc FY2026 guidance of Other Revenue $150–170M, RLDC margin 38–40%, Adjusted Operating Expense $570–585M, and through-cycle USDC CAGR 40%. Negative axes use at least two of RI<666, O<38, T<708; L<269 and M<38; A<125 and AM<46; or an adverse/no-favorable guidance revision. Reaffirmed or omitted guidance is neutral; explicit withdrawal is adverse. HOLD when all axes are neutral—the ordinary no-material-surprise case—or whenever positive and negative axes coexist, components within an axis materially disagree, guidance changes in opposite directions without a quantified net bridge, or the evidence is otherwise materially mixed. Do not use EPS, GAAP net income, June 30 USDC alone, qualitative partnerships, later call commentary, or optional platform metrics to escape HOLD.

WEAK_SELL.condition: Using only the first complete official Q2 2026 release/8-K for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (USD millions), set RI=Reserve Income, O=Other Revenue, T=RI+O after removing separately quantified Arc-token operating revenue/gains, C=Total Distribution, Transaction and Other Costs on the same scope, L=T−C, M=100×L/T, A=current-definition Adjusted EBITDA after removing separately quantified Arc effects, and AM=100×A/L. Engine− means at least two of RI<666, O<38, T<708; Capture− means L<269 and M<38; Profit− means A<125 and AM<46. Engine+ means at least two of RI>685, O>43, T>728; Capture+ means L>291 and M>40; Profit+ means A>143 and AM>50. Outlook− means at least one unambiguously adverse and no favorable like-for-like revision from ex-Arc FY2026 guidance of Other Revenue $150–170M, RLDC margin 38–40%, Adjusted Operating Expense $570–585M, or through-cycle USDC CAGR 40%; Outlook+ is the reverse. Reaffirmed or omitted guidance is neutral; withdrawal is adverse; unbridged Arc-inclusive or opposite-direction changes are mixed. After excluding stronger sell tiers, select WEAK_SELL when at least one of Engine−, Capture−, Profit−, or Outlook− holds, every remaining axis is neutral or negative, and no Engine+, Capture+, Profit+, Outlook+, internal metric conflict, or mixed guidance exists. This does not require every field to miss. Integrity requires T, C, A and its Q1-2026-definition reconciliation; a bridge for material Arc effects; same-definition June 30 USDC within $0.5B of $73.269B or an explanation; explanation of an issuer-input reserve-income identity difference over 3%; and no material reserve/depeg, attestation, security, partner, regulatory, or release/8-K conflict.

MEDIUM_SELL.condition: Using only the first complete official Q2 2026 release/8-K for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (USD millions), set RI=Reserve Income, O=Other Revenue, T=RI+O after removing separately quantified Arc-token operating revenue/gains, C=Total Distribution, Transaction and Other Costs on the same scope, L=T−C, M=100×L/T, A=current-definition Adjusted EBITDA after removing separately quantified Arc effects, and AM=100×A/L. Engine− means at least two of RI<666, O<38, T<708; Capture− means L<269 and M<38; Profit− means A<125 and AM<46. Engine+ means at least two of RI>685, O>43, T>728; Capture+ means L>291 and M>40; Profit+ means A>143 and AM>50. Outlook− means at least one unambiguously adverse and no favorable like-for-like change versus ex-Arc FY2026 guidance of Other Revenue $150–170M, RLDC margin 38–40%, Adjusted Operating Expense $570–585M, and through-cycle USDC CAGR 40%; Outlook+ is the reverse. Reaffirmed or omitted guidance is neutral; explicit withdrawal is adverse; opposing or unbridged Arc-inclusive changes are mixed. After excluding STRONG_SELL, select MEDIUM_SELL when at least two of Engine−, Capture−, Profit−, and Outlook− hold, at least one is Capture− or Profit−, no Engine+, Capture+, Profit+, Outlook+, or internally mixed axis exists, and the integrity checks in this condition pass. Integrity requires T, C, A and its Q1-2026-definition reconciliation; a numerical bridge for material Arc contamination; same-definition June 30 USDC within $0.5B of $73.269B or an explanation; explanation of any issuer-input reserve-income identity difference over 3%; and no material reserve/depeg, attestation, security, partner, regulatory, or release/8-K conflict. Neutral secondary evidence is permitted.

STRONG_SELL.condition: Using only the first complete official Q2 2026 release/8-K for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (USD millions), set RI=Reserve Income, O=Other Revenue, T=RI+O after removing separately quantified Arc-token operating revenue/gains, C=Total Distribution, Transaction and Other Costs on the same scope, L=T−C, M=100×L/T, A=Adjusted EBITDA under the Q1 2026 definition after removing separately quantified Arc effects, and AM=100×A/L. Engine− means at least two of RI<666, O<38, T<708; Capture− means L<269 and M<38; Profit− means A<125 and AM<46. An adverse outlook item means: the ex-Arc FY2026 Other Revenue range has neither endpoint higher and midpoint<160; RLDC-margin range has neither endpoint higher and midpoint<39; Adjusted Operating Expense range has neither endpoint lower and midpoint>577.5; through-cycle USDC CAGR is <40%; or comparable guidance is explicitly withdrawn. Outlook− requires at least one adverse and no favorable item. Decisive Engine− means at least two of RI≤655, O≤33, T≤695; decisive Capture− means L≤255 and M≤37; decisive Profit− means A≤115 and AM≤44.
